{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A tailored wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#3a3f45), cut with a sharp lapel and structured shoulders, falling to the hip with clean lines.
High-rise tailored trousers in matching charcoal wool-blend, straight-leg cut extending to the ankle for a streamlined silhouette.
A crisp white poplin blouse with a pointed collar, tailored fit with slight gathering at the waist, ending just above the hips.
Closed-toe pumps in polished black leather with a moderate heel, sleek almond shape complementing the professional attire.
Simple gold stud earrings and a thin silver chain necklace to add subtle elegance without distraction.

This outfit perfectly balances the office environment with the demanding conditions of an autumn morning walk in frost and snow. The charcoal wool-blend offers necessary warmth against the cold while maintaining a polished, professional appearance suitable for a work setting. The neutral palette allows her warm skin tones (#f0d6d2) to stand out, while the structured tailoring creates a confident silhouette during movement. Minimal accessories ensure she remains focused and efficient throughout her morning commute and daily tasks."}
